sources.decision: Reviewed current official news for post-November-15 additions. No additional playable catalog form was established by the reviewed current events.

November 21 Community Day introduces Kingambit Kowtow Cleave via event evolution; PvPoke now recommends it with limited access. The temporary evolution requirement ended at 21:00 local time and is not made permanent in the catalog.
November 16-23 event returns existing Dynamax species and Eternatus. Eternamax Eternatus cannot be caught; no playable Eternamax evolution is added.
Mega Clefable debuts November 28. Keep its raid recommendation deferred and source evidence retained.
November 24-30 event is upcoming; returning encounters do not establish a new playable form.

notes: Catalog IDs are unchanged at 1,637; all previous forms are retained.
Hisuian Sliggoo and Goodra now have exact-form PvPoke ranks, all outside the top-100 recommendation cutoff.
The existing Gigantamax Melmetal exclusion remains in place; the refreshed source rating alone does not establish a verified GO debut.
PokeMiners templates still predate the regional debuts; exact-form gender and trade metadata remain unverified.
